label: Human
description: Pauses the run until a person submits a form, then continues with their answers; use it for review or approval mid-run. A run that cannot pause holds its worker instead: while its caller is on the line, for as long as the caller stays; an unrecorded run, up to its trigger's `holdSecs`, then it fails saying it gave up. A person who skips the form ends this node skipped, with every output closed. Each form field adds input and/or output ports by its kind.
